Molly hosts Oktoberfest in the Midwest and makes her favorite German-inspired dishes, starting with salty pretzels with beer cheese and sweet pretzels with cinnamon sugar; crispy chicken schnitzel; German potato salad loaded with bacon.

Addicted to Chocolate
Molly Yeh shares her favorite choco-licious recipes to curb the cravings; she makes s'mores pie, chocolate sea salt rugelach and mini marzipan treats; rich and gooey Turkish coffee brownies will be enough to satisfy any chocolate appetite.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:

Molly Yeh throws a baby shower on the farm; she makes savory lentil soup in bread bowls and crave-worthy chicken Caesar salad wraps with crispy cheese; for dessert, there are glossy pink glazed yeasted donuts.

description:

description:
S23 E14 — The Pie's the Limit
Ree Drummond is in a pie state of mind, so she starts by making an incredibly decadent and party-worthy Double chocolate pie with a torched meringue topping; a fantastic waffle cone ice cream pie with shortcuts.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S33 E08 — Housewarming Treats
Ree Drummond prepares fall sweets for visitors at her and her sister's remodeled home, by starting the housewarming with her classic s'mores cookies, shortcut cherry cheesecake brownie cups, easy apple fritters, and pumpkin pie snacking granola.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S35 E12 — Treats for Todd
Ree Drummond has a care package for her youngest college kid, Todd; she's sending him mini strawberry tarts and chocolate hazelnut oatmeal bars to share with his roommates, cheesy chipotle cheddar snack mix and spirit pretzels in his team colors.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S27 E07 — Sweet Ways to Celebrate
Sweet ways to celebrate Valentine's Day; sake and miso-marinated salmon with coconut rice and broccolini; a brownie tart; mint chocolate bonbons.

title: The Kitchen
description:

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E02 — Jeffrey Garten
Jeffrey Garten joins Ina Garten to share highlights from their 60 years together, from love-at-first-sight encounters to their long-distance challenges; Ina makes easy butternut squash and apple soup; Jeffrey learns to make challah French toast.

description:

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S36 E03 — Sicilian and Seafood
Guy goes from incredible Italian to sensational seafood; wood-fired pizza; crab cake cioppino and crab-spinach risotto; Vanilla Ice at a pirate-inspired joint serving up Brazilian and Caribbean seafood specialties.

description:

Choi makes her popular Korean Burger recipe with a side of Broccoli with Crumbled Tofu. Then, Esther rounds out the meal with Hotteok, a crispy doughnut with a gooey apple center that can be enjoyed on its own or with a Gochujang Caramel sauce.

Esther Choi makes some favorite Korean classics; first, she picks the perfect flanken-cut short ribs for her Korean barbecue dish of LA Kalbi with Ssamjang; Esther's hot pot dish, Bulgogi Mushroom Jeongol, is all about savory bulgogi flavor.

Four fearless chefs play Guy's scary games for a stab at a $20,000 shopping spree; Guy gives chefs a frightening ingredient that they must feature in a spicy dish; remaining chefs must choose what to cook using spooky menu-item refrigerator magnets.

Ree Drummond is hoping to score big with dinner for the boys after quarterback training.

Ree Drummond downsizes dinner now that all her kids are grown and gone; she makes a small but scrumptious sausage and peppers 1/4 sheet pan pizza, and just the right amount of creamy pesto pasta.

Ree Drummond cleans out her kitchen by turning leftovers into dishes; she transforms her pantry and fridge odds and ends into Brown Sugar Buttermilk Waffles and more.

Shortcuts to weeknight meals start with Katie Lee's one pot beef bourguignon; Jeff Mauro makes an eggplant parm cheat sheet; Geoffrey Zakarian serves up galette; cookbook author Elizabeth Heiskell makes chocolate cobbler with cherry ice cream.

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S01 E05 — Trick or Treat: The Magic Castle
At the world-famous Magic Castle, host Josh Peck welcomes three magicians to face off against master sweets illusionist April Julian as they hunt for six secret sweets; can these professional prestidigitators spot the deceptions and win $12,000?

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S01 E06 — Trick or Treat: Kindergarten Halloween Party
Host Josh Peck joins three schoolteachers for a kindergarten classroom's Halloween party, where baker Ashley Holt has disguised six sweets as everyday objects; in the game of trick-or-treat, the teachers have to find them all to win $12,000!

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E06 — Back from the Dead: Final Four

title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
description:
S01 E03 — Pastry Cream Classics
Palmer challenges the nine chefs to face off in a showdown that tests their mastery of pastry cream; each chef must present their own interpretation of Boston cream pie, coconut cream pie or Italian rum cake to judges Duff Goldman and Shinmin Li.

title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
description:
S01 E04 — The Pastry Shop
Palmer divides the eight chefs into teams to craft laminated dough pastries worthy of display in a world-class pâtisserie case; each baker creates one sweet and one savory pastry for their team, hoping to impress judges Duff Goldman and Bryan Ford.

title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
description:
S01 E05 — Innovation
Jesse Palmer challenges the seven remaining chefs to find inspiration in grab-and-go gas station snacks; the bakers create their own interpretation of a classic dessert, like an opera cake or a Sachertorte, for judges Duff Goldman and Zac Young.
